description: Defines structs, enums, and functions for managing feature and workaround information in the ANGLE project, including feature categories, feature status, and feature management classes.

classes.name: Feature
classes.description: Represents a feature or workaround with properties like name, category, description, bug link, enabled status, and condition.

classes.name: FeatureSetBase
classes.description: Base class managing a collection of features, allowing feature override and listing.

methods.name: Feature::Feature(const char *name, const FeatureCategory &category, const char *description, FeatureMap *const mapPtr, const char *bug)
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a Feature with given properties and optionally adding it to a map.

methods.name: FeatureSetBase::overrideFeatures
methods.description: Overrides the enabled status of specified features.

methods.name: FeatureSetBase::populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates a list with the features in the set.
